outcome: Mode of labor in current pregnancy (repeat Cesarean section vs. vaginal birth)
cohort: Women with a previous elective Cesarean section for breech or cephalic presentation
finding: Women with a previous elective Cesarean section for breech presentation had a similar chance of having a repeat Cesarean section compared to women with a previous Cesarean section for cephalic presentation.
mod_finding: The rate of repeat Cesarean section was similar between women with a previous elective Cesarean section for breech presentation (70.22%) and those with a previous Cesarean section for cephalic presentation (73.87%).
